facts.text: Founded in 1891 as the Methodist Hospital School of Nursing, Nebraska Methodist College operates as an affiliate of the Methodist Health System.

sources.title: Accreditation And Affiliations | Nebraska Methodist College
sources.quote: Nebraska Methodist College has enjoyed a close relationship with Methodist Hospital, another affiliate of Methodist Health System, since the College was founded as the Methodist Hospital School of Nursing in 1891.

sources.title: What High School Juniors Can Do To Prepare for College
sources.quote: Established in 1891, NMC is an affiliate of the Methodist Health System and is fully accredited by The Higher Learning Commission of the North Central Association of Colleges and Schools.
